svg.title: All 36 fixed400 TRAIN and internal-monitor curves
svg.desc: Every model is included. Five actual snapshots per model. Shared vertical scale across panels. These are TRAIN and internal monitor, not OOF learning curves.
svg.text: Five actual snapshots: 0 / 100 / 200 / 300 / 400 updates. Fixed endpoint; no checkpoint selection.
Purple: internal monitor (excluded from gradients, scalers and selection)
Within-model comparisons only: objective scales/panels differ. These are exposed-TRAIN internal monitors; final OOF curves are not fabricated.
Lower is better. Panel metrics are component-equal aggregates. Loss decline is not evidence of landmark or Dope-state ranking lift.
